assumptions.statement: The submitted site and key-area polygons are provisional rough intake geometry, not official redlines or precise area bases.
assumptions.impact: All area, ratio, phasing and spatial claims are scenario quantities; replace geometry and recompute before statutory use.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Replace with organizer polygon; rerun spatial and metric checks.

assumptions.statement: The three named key areas are located from the cleared public task materials; their exact extents remain provisional.
assumptions.impact: Detailed-design interfaces are intentionally modular and must be clipped/recalculated when official extents arrive.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Recalculate key area areas, station assignment, and land-use interfaces.

assumptions.statement: FAR, height, density, ownership, utilities, road redlines and statutory control values are not available in the public package.
assumptions.impact: No parcel-level approval, final control, demolition order, or construction document is asserted.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Load official control schedule and confirm with licensed professionals.

assumptions.statement: Road and transit lines represent connectivity principles; they are not redlines or engineering alignments.
assumptions.impact: The proposal can compare seams and access but cannot authorize right-of-way or traffic operations.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Replace with surveyed centerlines and utility/traffic review.

assumptions.statement: Parcel ownership, lease terms and relocation conditions are unknown.
assumptions.impact: Retain/renovate/adaptive-new labels are option sets, not parcel conclusions.

assumptions.statement: Building footprints are deliberately sparse micro-station envelopes created for design testing.
assumptions.impact: Coverage ratio is conceptual and low confidence; heights and floor area remain unknown.

assumptions.statement: The proposal uses a non-locating cultural narrative and original abstract markers; no exact heritage control is inferred.
assumptions.impact: Landmark concepts are reversible interpretation devices, not claims about protected fabric.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Obtain heritage inventory and review each intervention.

assumptions.statement: Drainage, power, data, waste, emergency access and heat-island conditions are not verified.
assumptions.impact: Blue-green and service loops are performance hypotheses with maintenance gates.

assumptions.statement: Micro-station service protocols, staffing, data minimization and fallback procedures are design proposals.
assumptions.impact: All AI scenarios require human review, visible stop conditions and no-AI access.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Pilot one station with public, professional and privacy review.

assumptions.statement: International cases are mechanism references only; their outcomes and governance are not assumed to transfer automatically.
assumptions.impact: Local pilots must be evaluated against Beijing law, procurement and public-service duties.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Run local feasibility and legal review before adoption.

assumptions.statement: Chinese proposal is primary; English file is a faithful translation with shared IDs and values.
assumptions.impact: Reviewers can trace both languages to the same evidence chain.
